module: "Vehicle Touch" node (category `repeat_instant`, tags collision/collide/hit). Uses `map.objects[vehIdA].objectCollisions` to detect whether one vehicle touches another. Input pins: `flow`, `vehIdA`, `vehIdB` (optional). Outputs: `flow` (always true), `touching` (flow), `touchingb` (bool), and `vehId1` to `vehId5` (hidden: up to 5 touched ids, sorted, -1 if none). Without `vehIdB`, tests for any collision.
notes: The descriptions of `vehId1..5` are identical ("lowest-id-ed vehicle").

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Resets the outputs, then fills them from vehicle A's collision table.
